name: time-field
title: Time field
description: Hour, minute and AM/PM segments you step with arrow keys or type into.
a11y: A named group of spin buttons (Hour, Minute, AM or PM), each with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuetext.
ArrowUp/ArrowDown step a segment (minutes by the step prop), PageUp/PageDown step further, Home/End jump to the limits, Backspace clears.
Typing digits fills a segment and moves to the next; A and P set AM and PM.
ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move between segments and are mirrored in right-to-left.

props.name: value
props.description: The time as 24-hour `"HH:mm"` when controlled; `""` means none. Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial time as `"HH:mm"` when uncontrolled. Default none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with `"HH:mm"` once hour and minute are both set, or `""` when either is cleared.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: Show hours 1-12 with an AM/PM segment (`12`) or 0-23 (`24`). Default 12.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes the arrow keys move by. Default 1.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field as having an error: sets `aria-invalid` and shows the error border.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; a hidden input submits the 24-hour `"HH:mm"` value.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the group when it is not inside a Field. Default "Time".

usage:
import {Field, TimeField} from '@monoline/react';

<Field label="Start time"><TimeField defaultValue="09:30" /></Field>
